The '''Order of Yavin''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] military medal. It was awarded to Alliance forces who undertook the assault on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']] over [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].
